INJECTION.definition: G_I - G_A: compiled boundary value injected under the eager differentiation path
INJECTION.scope_or_uncertainty: 16 held-out SST-2 states, two deterministic repeats per state; state-level bootstrap interval

INTERACTION.scope_or_uncertainty: 16 held-out SST-2 states, two deterministic repeats per state; state-level bootstrap interval

REPAIR.definition: G_R - G_A: residual discrepancy after restoring eager boundary values under the compiled differentiation path
REPAIR.scope_or_uncertainty: 16 held-out SST-2 states, two deterministic repeats per state; this is residual discrepancy, not amount repaired

TOTAL.definition: G_B - G_A in the segmented eager/compiled program
TOTAL.scope_or_uncertainty: 16 held-out SST-2 states, two deterministic repeats per state; segmented-program total only

roles.evidence: The layer-0 boundary injection produces a nonzero full-gradient response, while large repair residual and interaction forbid localization to a unique upstream source.

algorithmic_rng.observation: the gradient endpoint and four-arm comparison contain no sampling draw

compiled_realization.observation: two tracked compiled segment graphs were warmed once and did not proliferate during measurement

confirmation_state_selection.observation: the first 16 held-out confirmation-bank states were selected by original order, not effect size

gpu_execution.observation: same-state repeat variance was zero for every reported contrast under two repeats

implementation_path.observation: eager/compiled prefix and suffix choices are fixed intervention arms, not runtime variance

sentence_and_label.observation: the same frozen sentence and label are supplied to every arm within a state

validity_gates.evidence: all 16 confirmation states used the predeclared original-order selection and four-arm layer-0 boundary
candidate calls were valid, no graph proliferation occurred after warmup, and self-pair metrics were exactly zero
segmented reference endpoint matched its monolithic anchor; segmented candidate endpoint did not, so the claim is explicitly limited to the segmented intervention program
